title: Evaluator Output
description: JSON produced by agent-meta-evaluator.py after re-running pycsl on a fixed file.

resolution_status.description: Whether the fix resolved the issue (e.g. 'resolved', 'still_failing').

new_ret_code.description: Return code of the pycsl re-run.

syntax_valid.description: Whether the modified file passes Python syntax check.

stdout.description: Captured stdout from the pycsl re-run.

stderr.description: Captured stderr from the pycsl re-run.
